title: Life Together
message: The earliest believers didn't just believe together — they lived together: devoted to the apostles' teaching, to fellowship, to breaking bread and to prayer. Faith in Christ is deeply personal, but it was never meant to be private. You are one part of a body that needs the other parts, and that needs you. Whatever step you take next — a church, a small group, one honest conversation — take it. Growth happens best next to other people, not apart from them.
explore: Christianity is personal but not private; believers belong to Christ and His people.
reflect: Who are the people helping you become more like Christ?
